blocks.original_text_excerpt: World Action Models (WAMs) have emerged as a promising alternative...
blocks.translation_excerpt: 世界动作模型正在成为具身控制中 VLA 的一种有前景替代方案。

blocks.original_text_excerpt: In this paper, we ask whether WAMs need explicit future imagination at test time...
blocks.translation_excerpt: 本文追问 WAM 是否需要在测试时显式想象未来。

blocks.original_text_excerpt: Building general-purpose embodied agents requires policies...
blocks.translation_excerpt: 构建通用具身智能体要求策略理解交互下的物理演化。

blocks.original_text_excerpt: Most existing WAMs follow an imagine-then-execute paradigm...
blocks.translation_excerpt: 多数现有 WAM 采用先想象、后执行范式。

blocks.original_text_excerpt: In this paper, we revisit this design choice and ask a simple question...
blocks.translation_excerpt: 本文将训练时视频目标与推理时未来生成解耦。

blocks.original_text_excerpt: Based on this perspective, we propose Fast-WAM...
blocks.translation_excerpt: Fast-WAM 将视频 DiT 改作单次前向的世界编码器。

blocks.original_text_excerpt: To study our central question in a controlled way...
blocks.translation_excerpt: 作者构建联合、IDM 与无视频协同训练变体。

blocks.original_text_excerpt: Experiments on simulation benchmarks show that Fast-WAM achieves strong results...
blocks.translation_excerpt: Fast-WAM 在仿真和真实任务中取得强结果并降低延迟。

blocks.original_text_excerpt: Our contributions are three-fold...
blocks.translation_excerpt: 本文贡献是提出问题、设计 Fast-WAM 并进行受控比较。

blocks.original_text_excerpt: Vision-Language-Action Policies. Recent progress...
blocks.translation_excerpt: VLA 继承网络规模图文预训练的语义先验。

blocks.original_text_excerpt: World Action Models and Video-based Robot Policies...
blocks.translation_excerpt: 基于视频的策略通过未来视觉预测建模动力学并推断动作。

blocks.original_text_excerpt: Our work is also related to recent efforts that exploit video modeling...
blocks.translation_excerpt: Fast-WAM 关注同一框架下两个因素的解耦。

blocks.original_text_excerpt: We consider embodied policy learning from visual observations and language instructions...
blocks.translation_excerpt: 标准视觉运动策略直接预测动作块。

blocks.original_text_excerpt: WAMs augment this formulation by introducing future visual observations...
blocks.translation_excerpt: WAM 将未来视觉观测作为中间变量。

blocks.original_text_excerpt: In practice, this is typically implemented either by jointly denoising...
blocks.translation_excerpt: 实际实现分为联合去噪与先视频后动作两类。

blocks.original_text_excerpt: Our starting point is the observation that the effectiveness of WAMs may arise from two distinct factors...
blocks.translation_excerpt: Fast-WAM 将视频训练信号与推理时未来生成解耦。

blocks.original_text_excerpt: Fast-WAM has a direct-policy interface at test time...
blocks.translation_excerpt: 动作以单次编码得到的潜在世界表征为条件。

blocks.original_text_excerpt: Overview. Fast-WAM is designed to preserve the training benefits...
blocks.translation_excerpt: 训练联合视频与动作，推理只保留首帧 latent。

blocks.original_text_excerpt: Architecture. Fast-WAM is built on top of the video Diffusion Transformer...
blocks.translation_excerpt: 模型采用 Wan2.2-5B、T5、VAE 与动作专家 DiT。

blocks.original_text_excerpt: We organize the input tokens into three groups...
blocks.translation_excerpt: 结构化掩码隔离未来视频 token 与动作 token。

blocks.original_text_excerpt: This ensures that both video modeling and action prediction are grounded...
blocks.translation_excerpt: 推理时完全移除未来视频分支。

blocks.original_text_excerpt: Training objective. Fast-WAM is trained with a joint flow matching objective...
blocks.translation_excerpt: 对动作或视频目标在数据与高斯噪声间插值。

blocks.original_text_excerpt: The model is trained to predict the corresponding velocity field...
blocks.translation_excerpt: 模型通过流匹配学习速度场。

blocks.original_text_excerpt: We instantiate this objective for both action generation and video co-training...
blocks.translation_excerpt: 总损失由动作损失和加权视频损失组成。

blocks.original_text_excerpt: To answer our central question... we design a set of controlled variants...
blocks.translation_excerpt: Joint 与 IDM 变体分别代表两类未来想象路径。

blocks.original_text_excerpt: We further construct a Fast-WAM variant without video co-training...
blocks.translation_excerpt: 无视频协同训练版本直接控制视频目标的作用。

blocks.original_text_excerpt: We use pretrained Wan2.2-5B as the backbone...
blocks.translation_excerpt: 总模型 6B，动作专家 1B，动作跨度 32。

blocks.original_text_excerpt: We use the same flow-matching formulation for both branches...
blocks.translation_excerpt: 推理 10 步，延迟在单张 RTX 5090D V2 上测量。

blocks.original_text_excerpt: We build Fast-WAM-Joint by allowing attention...
blocks.translation_excerpt: Joint 开放跨模态注意，IDM 对真实视频做噪声增强。

blocks.original_text_excerpt: We evaluate Fast-WAM and its variants on both simulation benchmarks...
blocks.translation_excerpt: 评估覆盖 LIBERO、RoboTwin 与真实任务。

blocks.original_text_excerpt: LIBERO. We follow the standard benchmarking protocol...
blocks.translation_excerpt: LIBERO 共 40 个任务和 2,000 次评估。

blocks.original_text_excerpt: RoboTwin 2.0 is a challenging bimanual manipulation benchmark...
blocks.translation_excerpt: RoboTwin 混合干净与重随机化数据训练。

blocks.original_text_excerpt: Real-World Evaluation. We conduct real-world evaluation on towel folding...
blocks.translation_excerpt: 真实任务使用 60 小时遥操作毛巾折叠数据。

blocks.original_text_excerpt: Table 1 and Table 2 summarize the results... On RoboTwin, Fast-WAM achieves 91.8%...
blocks.translation_excerpt: Fast-WAM 在 RoboTwin 达到 91.8%。

blocks.original_text_excerpt: On LIBERO, Fast-WAM also delivers strong overall performance...
blocks.translation_excerpt: Fast-WAM 在 LIBERO 达到 97.6%。

blocks.original_text_excerpt: Across both simulation benchmarks, the overall pattern is consistent...
blocks.translation_excerpt: 未来想象变体接近，去掉视频协同训练下降更大。

blocks.original_text_excerpt: This pattern suggests that the main benefit of WAM-style training...
blocks.translation_excerpt: 视频目标塑造世界落地表征是主要收益来源。

blocks.original_text_excerpt: On this task, pretrained pi0.5 remains the strongest method...
blocks.translation_excerpt: 预训练 pi0.5 最强，Fast-WAM 家族整体接近。

blocks.original_text_excerpt: In contrast, removing video co-training causes a dramatic degradation...
blocks.translation_excerpt: 移除视频协同训练使成功率降至 10%。

blocks.original_text_excerpt: In terms of runtime, Fast-WAM retains low inference latency...
blocks.translation_excerpt: Fast-WAM 延迟 190 ms，IDM 延迟 810 ms。

blocks.original_text_excerpt: In this paper, we revisited a basic question in World Action Models...
blocks.translation_excerpt: 视频预测可能主要作为训练表征目标发挥价值。
